name: MCP Server Cards
summary: MCP extension (SEP-2127, Final) defining a static JSON card that describes a remote MCP server's identity and transport endpoints so clients can find and connect to it.
description: SEP-2127 is Final (Extensions Track, identifier io.modelcontextprotocol/server-card); PR 2127 merged on 2026-10-06. The extension repo moved from experimental-ext-server-card to modelcontextprotocol/ext-server-card, but as of 2026-11-04 its README still says Experimental and the v1 $schema URL (static.modelcontextprotocol.io/schemas/v1/server-card.schema.json) returns 404. Recommended location is GET <streamable-http-url>/server-card, and cards can be discovered through AI Catalog entries. Cards carry name, version, remote endpoints, headers and supported protocol versions, but deliberately omit tool/resource listings and local-install metadata (that stays in the MCP Registry). TypeScript source of truth plus generated JSON Schema; Apache-2.0.
